## History

Kenneth was a former acquaintance who died after falling off a large load of hay as it was entering a barn. While his tragic death was remembered as part of local history, his memory was later discussed by the Meredith children during a gathering in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) graveyard.
